note: Maps each goal (and the 50+ age bands) to published blog posts. Slugs must match content/blog. The build fails if a slug here is not published. Always 3 cards: best matches first, then the next best posts.

posts.title: Fat Loss Without the Crash: Habits That Last
posts.description: Skip the crash diets. Learn the simple habits behind sustainable fat loss: protein, strength training, steps, sleep and a realistic pace.

posts.title: Beyond the Scale: Understanding Body Composition Changes
posts.description: Weight alone does not tell the whole story. Learn what body composition is, why the scale can stall while you improve, and simple ways to track real progress.

posts.title: Eating Vegan and Training Well: Protein and Nutrients
posts.description: Training on a vegan diet? See how to get enough protein, iron, calcium and B12, and build simple plant-based meals that support your workouts.

posts.title: Eating for Performance: What to Have Before, During and After Training
posts.description: Fuel your training with simple food timing. See what to eat before, during and after a workout, how much to drink, and a sample day for active people.

posts.title: A Vegetarian Plate Built for Strength
posts.description: How to get enough protein, iron and other key nutrients on a vegetarian diet while you train, with simple meal ideas and common pitfalls.

posts.title: Strength Training After 50: Where to Start
posts.description: A plain-language guide to starting strength training after 50: the basic movements, a simple weekly plan, and how to progress safely.

posts.title: Exercise With Arthritis, Osteoporosis or Muscle Loss: Where to Start
posts.description: Living with arthritis, osteoporosis or age-related muscle loss? Learn why strength and balance work matter, how to start gently and when to ask your doctor.

posts.title: Mobility for Desk Workers: A 10-Minute Routine
posts.description: Stiff hips, tight shoulders and a sore neck from desk work? Try these simple movement breaks and a 10-minute mobility routine.

posts.title: Starting From Zero: Your First Month of Training
posts.description: New to exercise? A calm, week-by-week plan for your first month of training, with tips on soreness, habits and how to know it is working.

posts.title: Recovery Supplements: What Helps and What Is Mostly Hype
posts.description: Wondering which supplements help recovery? See why sleep, food and rest come first, what the evidence says about common products, and how to choose safely.
